row: QA-FROZEN-CHIPS-01, seen while setting up W2-R5 and W2-R6
setup: Five sentences pinned in dev_frozen_test_chips, one-chip row on, chip animation 'decode'

finding_1.what: The pinned batch drives the carousel, but no chip is badged Test.
finding_1.measured: Zero elements with class bonsai-preset-chip-test-badge in the panel while the pinned sentences were on screen.
finding_1.cause: There are two chip label renderers. PresetChipLabel (src/components/MainTabPresetAnimatedChips.tsx:231) draws the Test badge. The decode-mode chip draws its own label at src/components/MainTabPresetAnimatedChips.tsx:535 with the beta badge only - no Test badge and no Tip badge. The Deck has preset_chip_animation set to 'decode', so the badge never renders.
finding_1.why_it_matters: The badge exists so it is obvious at a glance that the carousel is not showing what the plugin would have chosen. With it missing, a pinned QA batch is indistinguishable from real chips.

finding_2.what: Pressing Right on a pinned chip did not bring in the next entry of the batch.
finding_2.measured: Ring on the chip showing entry 5 of 5; one Right press left the same chip on screen and the ring on it.
finding_2.caveat: One press, one state. advanceAtEnd only fires at the last chip of the carousel history, which may not have been the state here. Recorded as something to reproduce, not yet a bug.
